name: convention-selection-keys
description: A string at a selection key of an applied convention row, a key that only selects files to mutate or to cover, roots no file, so a file only such keys name is reported as never imported, in a JSON configuration file as in a module one. A key that loads a file still roots it, and a string in the configuration of a tool no applied row describes roots the file it names. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named stryker for the package @stryker-mutator/core whose selection keys hold mutate read from stryker.config.json, and a row named vitest for the package vitest whose selection keys hold test.coverage.include and test.coverage.exclude read from vitest.config.ts, each range holding the installed version.
